import itertools
from collections import defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
data=[]
for key in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    i=G[key+' input']; o=G[key+' output']
    h=len(o); w=len(o[0]); hr=next(r for r in range(h) if all(i[r][c]==3 for c in range(w))); vc=next(c for c in range(w) if all(i[r][c]==3 for r in range(h)))
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r==hr or c==vc: continue
            qr = 0 if r<hr else 1
            qc = 0 if c<vc else 1
            dr = min(hr-1-r, r-hr)  # distance to nearest horizontal border edge (cross row)

import os,re,json
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
trip=[]
for key in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    i=G[key+' input']; o=G[key+' output']
    h=len(o); w=len(o[0]); hr=next(r for r in range(h) if all(i[r][c]==3 for c in range(w))); vc=next(c for c in range(w) if all(i[r][c]==3 for r in range(h)))
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r==hr or c==vc: continue
            dr = hr-1-r if r<hr else r-hr
            dc = vc-1-c if c<vc else c-vc
            trip.append((dr,dc,o[r][c]))
tbl=defaultdict(Counter)
for dr,dc,v in trip: tbl[(dr,dc)][v]+=1
print('inconsistent:',sum(1 for k in tbl if len(k)>1))
# print unified table
for k in sorted(tbl): print(k, dict(tbl[k]))

import os,re,json,itertools,math
from collections import defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def parse_grid(key):
    i=G[key+' input']; o=G[key+' output']
    H=len(o); W=len(o[0]); hr=next(r for r in range(H) if all(i[r][c]==3 for c in range(W))); vc=next(c for c in range(W) if all(i[r][c]==3 for r in range(H)))
    return i,o,H,W,hr,vc
# Build unified dataset from both demos

    for r in range(H):

            D.append((abs(r-hr)-1, abs(c-vc)-1, o[r][c]))
print('samples:',len(D))
ys=set(v for _,_,v in D); print('values',ys)

from collections import defaultdict
def load():

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
